ABOUT THE ATLAS

A field guide, made by fans.

Where our information comes from, and what each page covers.

Roster coverage

The directory includes the 41 character entries listed in Kaiden’s Stella Sora character directory when checked on October 23, 2026. Named variants are separate entries. This is a dated snapshot, not a live connection to the game.

Artwork and attributes

Names, elements, and rarity labels are cross-checked with the character directory. Full character artwork and Japanese voice credits are taken from the official Stella Sora website where available. Additional character portraits are game artwork sourced through Kaiden. Stella Sora and its artwork belong to Yostar.

Guides and character notes

The eight guides are original introductory advice. Character pages include sourced profile attributes and general planning notes. These notes are not tested individual builds. We do not invent missing skill values, equipment recommendations, or combat results.

Visual identity

Typography uses Poppins and Oswald, both declared by the official Stella Sora website. The cyan, indigo, pale blue and yellow palette is adapted from its web styles. This identifies the official website fonts, not verified in-client font usage. The wiki navigation takes inspiration from Prydwen and Kaiden. Font licenses are included with the site assets.

Your tier list and saved characters

The tier list is a personal board. It is not an authoritative meta ranking. Saved characters and ranks stay in local browser storage; they are not automatically synced between devices. No account is required for these features.
